new_today_news.headline: RTI Cooperates with Phillips 66 on UCO Collection and SAF Production
new_today_news.summary: Restaurant Technologies Inc. is working with Phillips 66 on sustainable aviation fuel production, collecting UCO from its network of some 45,000 restaurants, hotels, casinos, colleges and other food service operations in more than 40 markets nationwide. RTI supplies Phillips 66 with high quality, traceable, ISCC-certified UCO to support SAF production at the Phillips 66 Rodeo Renewable Energy Complex in California.

new_today_news.headline: Fastmarkets discontinues price assessments for used cooking oil, delivered Atlantic Seaboard and Southeast US
new_today_news.summary: Fastmarkets discontinued Yellow grease price assessments effective November 3, 2026 for US Pacific Northwest and New York markets, citing sustained lack of observable spot market activity following a June 2026 proposal notice.

recent_news.headline: Phillips 66 and Restaurant Technologies (RTI) Announce Long-Term UCO Supply Agreement for SAF Production
recent_news.summary: Phillips 66 and Restaurant Technologies (RTI) have a long-term agreement to supply used cooking oil from U.S. restaurants to produce renewable fuels in California. RTI supplies Phillips 66 with high quality, traceable, ISCC certified UCO to support renewable diesel and SAF production at the Phillips 66 Rodeo Renewable Energy Complex in California, one of the largest renewable fuels facilities in the world.

recent_news.headline: Grease caused 47 percent of reported sewer blockages behind overflows
recent_news.summary: News article citing EPA findings that grease is the most common reported cause of sewer blockages, representing 47% of blockages that lead to overflows. Plano utilities and local agencies emphasize proper FOG disposal.

recent_news.headline: Debris Removal Insurance: Costs and Coverage for 2026
recent_news.summary: National averages for debris removal insurance as of October 2026 show general liability averaging $79/month, business owner's policies at $146/month, and commercial property insurance at $64/month. Pricing varies based on project types, locations, payroll, and vehicle types.

backfill_news.headline: Waynesville seeks $150,000 to curb grease clogs in sewer lines
backfill_news.summary: Waynesville, North Carolina is formalizing its FOG (fats, oils, and grease) program and seeking $150,000 in funding to address grease blockages in sewer lines. The initiative includes educational opportunities for the community and enforcement of FOG management requirements.

backfill_news.headline: Diamond Green Diesel Reports Q3 2026 Results: 314.9M Gallons Sold with $1.30 Adjusted EBITDA per Gallon
backfill_news.summary: Diamond Green Diesel Q3 2026 results were released by Darling Ingredients' joint venture partner. DGD sold/shipped 314.9 million gallons of renewable fuels in the quarter, with adjusted EBITDA per gallon of $1.30. The JV partner reported that its renewable diesel segment earned approximately $350 million in operating income for the three months ended Sept. 30, 2026.
